correctness.rationale: The determinant-one Haar coordinate transform yields five explicit affine forms. Inversion, half-lattice translations and surjectivity of nonparallel integer torus homomorphisms force every nonconstant Walsh moment except one to vanish. Exact Fraction-based polygon clipping exhaustively partitions the square into 168 rational polygons to recover all 32 word probabilities; an independent four-form partition (156 regions) obtains the exceptional moment 1/21. Geometry justifies that finite clipping proves the exact integral, not an extrapolated approximation.

value.rationale: The natural first-coordinate half-circle observation of the standard hyperbolic cat map has a sharp four-to-five-block transition: its four-block law is exactly fair Bernoulli, but the five-block law has a unique explicit fourth interaction 1/21 and strictly positive exact conditional information. This is a complete nontrivial short-block invariant for a canonical dynamical system, not an arbitrary slice.
